# Phodex

> Phodex is an open-source, self-hostable mobile app (Flutter) and backend (FastAPI) for running AI coding agents — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Anthropic Managed Agents — from a phone. The agent is launched only after an approval tap on the phone, and Phodex's own commit-and-push step is held behind a second confirmation tap. Open source under the MIT License on GitHub. Solo portfolio project by Gaurav Singh.

Phodex has two runtimes. Desktop: the backend runs on the developer's laptop, the phone pairs over a QR code, and git credentials never leave the machine. Cloud: the same backend runs on a server the operator deploys and clones GitHub repositories itself. Live task events stream over Server-Sent Events. Status: the code is public, but no public backend is deployed, the app is not in any app store, and the code is MIT-licensed.
